data.name: Vivek Chaturvedi
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Vivek Chaturvedi has made a big mark in cricket. With 32 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 62*, with an average of 14.12 and a quick strike rate of 147.98. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 11 sixes and 40 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.0 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 12.56. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
